what: Blind reading (AI reading agent, 2026-11-19, report line KHANSI) of the Supplementary Information of Khan, Shi, Feser, Wilson, Appl. Phys. Lett. 125, 041601 (2024), doi 10.1063/5.0220124 (OSTI 2578597), and of Hopkins, Salaway, Stevens, Norris, Int. J. Thermophys. 28, 947 (2007). Not checked by a person.

khan2024_si.tin_growth: reactive DC magnetron sputtering in N2/Ar; growth temperature not stated
khan2024_si.oxide_removal: all substrates HF-dipped about 10 s ('surface oxides were removed by HF dipping')
khan2024_si.models: Landauer formula (Eq. 1) over the full Brillouin zone with DFPT dispersions (Quantum ESPRESSO, PBE, PAW; 4x4x4 force constants interpolated to 50x50x50) for TiN, diamond and Si only; DMM alpha = I2/(I1+I2) (Reddy, full dispersion); elastic limit alpha = 1 if I1 < I2 else I2/I1; Gmax: alpha = 1
khan2024_si.electron_phonon: TiN volumetric e-ph coefficient ~1e18 W m^-3 K^-1 (Dal Forno, their ref. 39) times 1-2 Angstrom gives ~0.1 GW m^-2 K^-1, about one tenth of the TiN/Si G; called 'unlikely' to matter
khan2024_si.error_bars: contour analysis of the RMS fit deviation, electron thermal conductivity +-10 %, phonon part +-50 %; relative error Ge 12->28 %, Si 18->37 %, SiC ~26 %, C 20->23 % (300 K -> 770/996 K)

hopkins2007.reading_uncertainty: +-3 % in T and in G (log-log axes)
hopkins2007.error_bars: none plotted; text: '<10% from the mean'
hopkins2007.surface_prep: sapphire 'factory polished', solvent spin clean, 5 min 400 K bake, 5 min 100 W backsputter
hopkins2007.units: T in K, G in MW m^-2 K^-1
hopkins2007.note: Khan Fig. S25's Pt/Al2O3 comparison cites Hopkins, Norris and Stevens, J. Heat Transfer 130 (2008), not this paper
